[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/harfbuzz/test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":7,"var":"data,size","code":"hb_blob_create((const char *)data, size, HB_MEMORY_MODE_READONLY, NULL, NULL)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped in an hb_blob_t so the rest of the shaping pipeline reads the raw input as a font file."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/harfbuzz/test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":8,"var":"blob","code":"hb_face_create(blob, 0)","note":"The blob becomes an hb_face_t, making the input the backing store for OpenType table parsing."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/harfbuzz/test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":9,"var":"face","code":"hb_font_create(face)","note":"A font object is created from the attacker-controlled face and will later dispatch metric queries into the OpenType backend."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-ot-font.cc","function":"hb_ot_font_set_funcs","line":242,"var":"font","code":"hb_font_set_funcs(font, _hb_ot_get_font_funcs(), ot_face, nullptr)","note":"OpenType font callbacks are installed, binding glyph advance queries to the hmtx/vmtx accelerators built from the input font."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/harfbuzz/test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":13,"var":"buffer","code":"hb_buffer_add_utf8(buffer, text, -1, 0, -1); hb_shape(font, buffer, NULL, 0)","note":"Shaping drives glyph lookup and metric retrieval on the attacker-controlled font, reaching the OpenType metric callbacks."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-ot-font.cc","function":"hb_ot_get_glyph_h_advances","line":67,"var":"first_glyph","code":"*first_advance = font->em_scale_x (hmtx.get_advance (*first_glyph, font));","note":"Each shaped glyph triggers a horizontal advance lookup through the hmtx accelerator."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-ot-hmtx-table.hh","function":"hmtxvmtx::accelerator_t::get_advance","line":268,"var":"advance","code":"unsigned int advance = get_advance (glyph); if (likely(glyph < num_metrics)) advance += (font->num_coords ? var_table->get_advance_var (...) : 0);","note":"The base advance is read from the parsed hmtx table and then conditionally adjusted by variation data."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-ot-hmtx-table.hh","function":"hmtxvmtx::accelerator_t::get_advance","line":271,"var":"var_table->get_advance_var(glyph, font->coords, font->num_coords)","code":"advance += (font->num_coords ? var_table->get_advance_var (glyph, font->coords, font->num_coords) : 0);","note":"When the font has variation coordinates, the code dereferences the HVAR/VVAR variation table pointer without first proving that the variation table was actually loaded."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-ot-hmtx-table.hh","function":"hmtxvmtx::accelerator_t::get_advance","line":271,"var":"var_table","code":"var_table->get_advance_var (...)","note":"If the input font lacks a valid HVAR/VVAR table but still reaches this path with num_coords set, the null/invalid variation-table access causes the MSAN crash observed in the report."}
]
